state_clock: 0 loading + 2 laden + 1 discharge + 2 ballast; every turn exactly ten operating days
execution_rule: bounded catch-up intention from physical backlog; independent of quotation price or pressure memory
cpi_rule: last completed annual level before the current year; initial year uses initial condition
inventory_scope: transport plan deviation, not absolute regional or refinery stocks
source_projection: preserve monthly daily rate, not real-calendar monthly volume; log the difference
pricing_curve_changed: new bounded recent pressure and anchored soft price bounds; pure v0.2.1 kernel unchanged
